svg.title: Standing wave formed by two waves traveling in opposite directions
svg.desc: Five snapshots at t = 0, T/4, T/2, 3T/4 and T. In each, wave 1 moves left and wave 2 moves right, and the resultant below them is their sum. The resultant oscillates in place: its nodes, marked by vertical lines, never move, and its amplitude swings from twice that of each wave (constructive interference) through zero (destructive interference) and back.
